data.description:
## Story

As a release engineer completing the Closure Checks migration, I can run a multi-opus coherence gate that walks all migrated planning artifacts and verifies internal consistency — catching cases where `## Closure Checks` and `## Success Criteria` sections conflict, overlap, or contain items in the wrong section.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: Coherence gate script created at `plugins/dso/scripts/coherence-walk.sh` (or equivalent); accepts a list of ticket IDs (or scans all open epics/stories) and runs an opus-tier analysis across migrated artifacts
- DD2: Gate emits a structured per-artifact verdict — `PASS`, `FAIL <reason>`, or `AMBIGUOUS <reason>` — plus an aggregate summary line
- DD3: Gate integrated into the validation pipeline (runnable via `dso validate.sh --ci` or equivalent); SC10 passes when gate exits 0 (all PASS)
- DD4: Gate output includes: per-artifact findings, overall verdict, and a **recommended next step** for FAIL/AMBIGUOUS results (create bug ticket via dso ticket create bug, or escalate to user)

← Satisfies: "SC10: multi-opus coherence gate implemented and integrated into validation pipeline"

## Considerations

- **FAIL/AMBIGUOUS re-entry path**: Gate must document a clear re-entry path — FAIL/AMBIGUOUS verdicts should trigger an automatic bug ticket creation (using the `create-bug` skill) or explicit user escalation via AskUserQuestion. An unhandled FAIL/AMBIGUOUS with no documented follow-up creates a dead end for automated sprint runs.
- Gate runs **after** S5 migration completes — do not run against partially migrated ticket sets, as backward-compat (no section = pass) will mask real issues.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
data.title: As a release engineer, I can run a multi-opus coherence gate to verify planning artifact consistency after Closure Checks migration
